method.name: nonparametric_question_cluster_bootstrap
method.within_replicate_aggregation: pooled unit-weighted mean, matching the point estimator

conflict_classifications.rule: EO_raw > tolerance: evidence-side; EO_raw < -tolerance: label-side; otherwise tie

interpretation: Positive EO_raw and EO_normalized values are evidence-side; negative values are label-side. Evidence Override is signed proximity in the conflict condition and does not by itself identify a causal mechanism.
